# FlatRate ISO

> FlatRate ISO (flatrateiso.com) is an agent and ISO partner program in the payments industry — recruiting and equipping sales agents to sell merchant services and credit card processing. Up to 90% splits, lifetime residuals, $0 to join, free partner website and business setup, training, and back-office support. Phone: 470-672-7198.

FlatRate ISO is for people who want to build residual income by selling payment processing — no upfront cost and no experience required. A division of Flat Rate Processing (flatrateprocessing.com). Agents earn high splits with lifetime residuals on the accounts they sign, and get a free branded partner website, email, phone, and domain to launch with.

## Key pages

- [Apply](https://flatrateiso.com/apply.html): Apply to become a payment processing agent
- [Splits](https://flatrateiso.com/splits.html): Residual split tiers (up to 90%) and how payouts work
- [How It Works](https://flatrateiso.com/how-it-works.html): The agent onboarding and support process
- [Verticals](https://flatrateiso.com/verticals.html): The business types agents can sign
- [Government Program](https://flatrateiso.com/government.html): Municipal/government payment opportunities
- [Partner Launch Kit](https://flatrateiso.com/partner-launch-kit.html): The free website, email, phone, and domain new partners receive

## Facts

- Up to 90% residual splits with lifetime residuals on signed accounts
- $0 to join, no experience required
- New partners receive a free website, business email, phone, and domain
- Agent/ISO recruitment is FlatRate ISO's focus; merchant processing itself is handled by the sister company Flat Rate Processing (https://flatrateprocessing.com)
